name: Ingrid Grimwall
source:
Forging the sharpest steel of the fires in her backyard, Ingrid was determined to mark her brand in history with her weapons. While most wars are fought today with ranged weapons, the Ultimate Blacksmith finds beauty in the melee weapons of old, in both their shapes and fighting styles. Great patience and attention to detail is required to forge the blades of warriors past, and those made by Ingrid are sure to slice cleanly through your opponents (or just look good hanging over a fireplace).

[From [url=https://twitter.com/ProjEdensGarden/status/1357134477336707072]official description[/url]]
